about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: We help you find the best insurance at the best price by comparing top insurance companies in the Kingdom
about.missionP1: At Taminkom, we believe everyone deserves the best insurance coverage at the best price. That's why we created a comprehensive online platform that lets you compare insurance offers from the top licensed insurance companies in Saudi Arabia.
about.missionP2: We save you time and effort and ensure complete transparency in displaying prices and coverage, so you can make an informed decision that suits your needs and budget.
about.visionText: To be the leading and most trusted platform for comparing and purchasing insurance in Saudi Arabia
about.valueTransparencyDesc: We display all information clearly with no hidden fees
about.valueSpeedDesc: Get comparison quotes in less than 3 minutes
about.valueSecurityDesc: Your data is protected with the highest information security standards
about.valueTrustDesc: We only work with licensed and accredited insurance companies
about.reasonSaveDesc: Compare over 8 insurance companies and choose the best for your budget. Our customers saved an average of 35% on their premiums.
about.reasonFastDesc: Complete the entire process online in minutes. No need to visit branches or submit paperwork.
about.reasonCompareDesc: Compare coverage, prices, and benefits side by side to make the best decision based on accurate information.
about.regulatedDesc: Taminkom is an online insurance comparison platform in Saudi Arabia. We comply with all regulations to protect customer rights and ensure service quality.
